commit 961c4328f5910ffcad16ae88ab85ed278d9d1f78
Author:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Wed Jul 31 18:23:12 2024 +0000
Commit:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Wed Jul 31 18:23:12 2024 +0000

    Bug 1907317 - Reconcile bouncer aliases across all branches. r=dandarnell
    
    This aligns comm-central with the current state of the bouncer aliases.
    comm-beta and comm-release can "ride the trains", and this should be uplifted
    to comm-esr128 once bug 1909482 is resolved.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D217456

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/release-bouncer-aliases/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/release-bouncer-aliases/kind.yml
index dcf826fa9e1..b703a58063b 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/release-bouncer-aliases/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/release-bouncer-aliases/kind.yml
@@ -47,14 +47,21 @@ tasks:
                 # thunderbird-msi-latest-ssl: msi
                 # thunderbird-msix-latest-ssl: msix
                 esr115:
+                    # esr115 is the last of the "esr" branches to use the
+                    # thunderbird-latest aliases that are moving to monthly
+                    # releases
+                    thunderbird-latest-ssl: installer-ssl
+                    thunderbird-latest: installer
+                    thunderbird-msi-latest-ssl: msi
+                    thunderbird-msix-latest-ssl: msix
+                esr128:
                     # when there is one ESR branch both sets of aliases work
-                    # when there are two ESR branches ...
-                    # ... these always point to the older branch
                     thunderbird-esr-latest-ssl: installer-ssl
                     thunderbird-esr-latest: installer
                     thunderbird-esr-msi-latest-ssl: msi
                     thunderbird-esr-msix-latest-ssl: msix
-                esr128:
+                    # when there are two ESR branches ...
+                    # ... these always point to the older branch
                     thunderbird-esr-next-latest-ssl: installer-ssl
                     thunderbird-esr-next-latest: installer
                     thunderbird-esr-next-msi-latest-ssl: msi
